title: Ask
lead: Write it as you would tell a colleague. This is not an AI that answers. It asks, in my order, and shows what it heard. When the starting point holds, you can send it to me.

doors.chat: Hand over a chat with an AI

chat_lead: Paste the conversation you already had with an AI about this. I read it for the same five lines; what it does not contain, I ask.
chat_placeholder: Paste the whole chat, your messages and the AI's answers.
heard_note: Mechanical reading, no model; nothing leaves this page until you send. Each line is your sentence. Confirm it or say it as it is.

chunks.label: Who has the problem, and who decides
What happens now, and the evidence
The people who use it day to day

objects.label: the product or app people use
the wording and what is said
data, numbers, a dataset or model

turns.heard: I heard: “{q}”. I put that under {label}.
turns.heard_object: I read this as being about {label}.
turns.solution: “{q}” reads as a solution. I put it under already decided. What happens now, and for whom? One observed fact is enough.
turns.method: A question about how I work is not a request; the task contract describes it. What is going on at your end?
turns.agent_alone: An agent asking on its own behalf is declined. Who is the person or organisation behind this?

ask.object: Where does this sit: the public site, the app people log into, the data, or how the organisation works?
ask.decision: You wrote “{q}”. What do you need to decide, or get moving, once this is clear?
ask.who: Who has this day to day, and who says yes?
ask.current: What happens now, and for whom? One observed fact is enough.
ask.users_asked: Has anyone who uses it day to day been asked? What did they say?

turns.correct: Say it as it is, and I replace the line.
turns.collected: That holds. The starting point is collected on the right; send it when you are ready.
turns.more: Anything else that is already decided, or that you take as given?

collected_label: Collected: a starting point for my lens.
send_note: Opens your mail program with the request filled in, your words and the collected lines. If it does not open, copy and paste it in a mail to
after: What happens then: I read it, mail the invoice from my own node, and the reply window of 7 days starts when the payment is seen. Nothing is paid on this page.
contract_line: What a request and an answer look like: the task contract.
